correctness.rationale: For X=ab+c with 1<=a<b and 0<=c<b, no carry when doubling forces S_b(2X)=4 S_b(X)=8X, contradicting S_b(2X)=X. With a required carry, 2X has digits (2a+1,2c-b) and the exact two cycle equations have c-resultant (b^2+1)(5a-b+3)(13a-b+5). The b=13a+5 branch yields c=5a+2 and violates 2c>=b. The surviving b=5a+3 branch gives c=3a+2; its digits obey all two-digit bounds, and substitution proves the converse for every a>=1. Independent SymPy resultant and direct bases 2..130 match. No finite search is the infinite proof.
